data.body: Classification: mechanical — test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh calls check-tag-guards.sh and check-reinvocation.sh, which invoke .claude/scripts/dso ticket show. That triggers _ensure_initialized in plugins/dso/scripts/ticket, which does git fetch origin tickets when the sync marker is absent. In CI the marker is never pre-warmed, so every ticket show fires a network fetch (~30-60s each). Fix: export _TICKET_TEST_NO_SYNC=1 at the top of the test file to use the documented skip path.
